claim:
Let \(X_8=(\mathbb R^2,N)\), where
\[
N(s,t)=\max\left\{|s|,|t|,\frac{|s|+|t|}{\sqrt2}\right\}.
\]
For \(\varepsilon\in[0,1)\), write \(u\perp_D^\varepsilon v\) when
\[
N(u+\lambda v)\ge \sqrt{1-\varepsilon^2}\,N(u)
\qquad(\lambda\in\mathbb R).
\]
Then the least \(\varepsilon\) such that
\[
x\perp_B y\Longrightarrow y\perp_D^\varepsilon x
\qquad(x,y\in X_8)
\]
is
\[
\varepsilon_D(X_8)=
\sqrt{\frac{5-2\sqrt2}{8}}.
\]
Equivalently,
\[
\inf_{\substack{x,y\in S_{X_8}\\x\perp_B y}}
\inf_{\lambda\in\mathbb R}N(y+\lambda x)
=
\frac{2+\sqrt2}{4}.
\]
Equality is attained by \(x=(1,\sqrt2-1)\), \(y=(0,-1)\), and their images under the dihedral norm symmetries.
integrity: The proof exhausts edge-interior and vertex Birkhoff pairs using the complete norming-functional sets. Every reverse line-distance lower bound from the dual norm is matched by an explicit translate, so the global infimum is exact.
scientific_limitations: The exact parameter is for the modified Dragomir approximate relation on the real regular octagonal plane. The distinct Chmieliński approximate-symmetry parameter and the full family of regular polygonal norms are not computed. The 2015 object source was inspected through publisher metadata and abstract rather than complete article text in this run.
title: Sharp Dragomir approximate-symmetry parameter of the regular octagonal plane
